blurb: Moto-i offers a modern Japanese-inspired dining experience featuring house-brewed sake, izakaya-inspired dishes, and a nightlife-driven atmosphere. Guests can enjoy ramen, steamed buns, and sake in a multi-level space with a lively street-level brewery, intimate lounge, and a seasonal rooftop with city views. The restaurant also hosts group dinners and private events with three distinct event spaces.
